name: nable
description: A cost guard for coding agents and local-first FinOps for Claude: prices what your agent is about to run, and answers what is driving your cloud and AI bill.

plugins.name: nable
plugins.description: Prices what your coding agent is about to do before it runs: asks before costly launches and destroys, tracks AI spend, and answers cost questions across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes and AI providers. Local, read-only. Includes /nable:guard and /nable:connect. Credentials stay on your machine.
